result:
PASS/FAIL requires an actual diff to audit — no diff was provided in this probe, so there are no changed instructions/consumers to enumerate against the matrix.

Concrete required workflow action: identify the changed authority (skill/agent/rule) and its consumers (main, implementer, reviewer, scorer, fresh session), then corroborate each consumer's delivery mechanism (always-loaded / paths-triggered / explicit Read / pasted) against source — not against main-session behavior, since that never proves fresh-child delivery.

Key safety gate: any load-bearing instruction whose delivery is `assumed`/`unconfirmed`, or whose child delivery is inferred rather than directly observed, fails the audit and must be repaired (explicit Read or drift-tested inline copy) or routed to `ESCALATIONS.md` before proceeding — this gate cannot be satisfied without a concrete diff to inspect.
